text: Stations A and C can both reach access point B but not each other. What problem is this and what is the mitigation?
choices: The hidden node problem; RTS/CTS, since the CTS from B is audible to both
explanation: Carrier sense fails because the relevant question is whether the medium is busy AT THE RECEIVER and the sender can only observe it at the sender. RTS/CTS costs two extra frames, which is why it is normally enabled only above a size threshold.
